note: Re-judged 2026-10-30 (independent auditor, after the user-namespace conversion): every tagged unit now opens with `if !userns.Enter(t) { return }`, which re-executes the test in its own user, network and mount namespace and carries the child's fail or skip to the parent (Enter, internal/test/userns/userns_linux.go), and the file builds under plain linux instead of integration && linux. RFC 9568 Section 7.1 says "It MUST verify that the VRID is configured on the receiving interface" TestRxAdvertScopedToReceivingInterface sends, for v2 and v3, a VRID 10 advert on the interface that holds only VRID 20 and fails if it reaches the VRID 10 instance, requires it to arrive at the VRID 20 instance (so absence is not vacuous) and decode there as ErrUnknownVRID, then requires the same advert on the VRID 10 interface to reach its instance and decode. Its other change is rp_filter 0 on the second macvlan so the IPv4 multicast is received at all. The unchanged packet/validate_test.go and rfc9568_rx_interface_v3_test.go tags stand. Verdict enforced.
